text: I'd love to have friends or family over often and spend time together at home.
I'd rather the kitchen and living room flow into one space where people can hang out, instead of being separated.
A big shared space we all use together matters more to me than a quiet space just for myself.
I prefer a clean, empty space with as few things around as possible.
I'd love generous storage so I can keep things out of sight and tidy.
I enjoy filling and decorating a space with objects and furniture I love.
I need a space at home for active hobbies like exercise, DIY, or hands-on projects.
Home is a place to rest and recover, not a place to do things.
I'd love a multi-purpose room I can use for different things (a home gym, a workshop, etc.).
I prefer a wide-open layout over a cozy space divided by walls.
I'm drawn to new styles or unconventional layouts.
A familiar, traditional layout feels more comfortable to me.
Big windows and natural light are the most important part of a space for me.
I love spending time on a balcony or terrace.
I want to fill my space with houseplants or natural materials like wood and stone.
